verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state Mercury Books generates P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet reports on demand ('from today's numbers, not last quarter's'), supports cash and accrual accounting, and reports are 'ready the moment you need them' due to real-time reconciliation. This directly matches the founder story of on-demand accurate financial statements for any period. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of report accuracy and period-selection flexibility, and Mercury's own admission that automation has limits ('not putting your books on autopilot') introduces some caveat about full accuracy without human review.
